title: The Aeroplane, 13 Feb 1948, p.186: annular aerofoils and Kitchen's doughnut (Figs. 3-5)
description: Continuation page of A. R. Weyl's flying saucer article in The Aeroplane discussing annular aerodynamics. Illustrations include "Fig. 3.—A simple experiment in annular aerofoils", "Fig. 4.—Principle of the Huth annular-biplane system", and a photograph captioned "Fig. 5. Kitchen's doughnut of 1911" showing an early ring-wing aircraft. Part of the inclosures to a US flying object report.
